text:
alex: Heads up — charts in Console EU canary are lagging since last telemetry client rollout. Main thread heavy parse, frames dropped. Anyone else seeing this? :frowning_face:

maya: saw spike in LCP and trace tails. heatmaps mostly. Timeline shows long parse at ~200ms and a few 300ms spikes on initial load.

sanjay: +1. bundle size jumped ~230KB after the telemetry bump (maybe inline sourcemap or extra deps). devtools shows telemetry-client bundle went 1.8MB -> 2.03MB.

lina: routing weights changed yesterday — we shifted a subset of sessions to eu-prefetch pool. Could be KV affinity churn causing extra backend fetches for charts.

jamal: sharing a perf snippet from a flame chart: 
```
MainThread: ParseHTML 120ms -> TelemetryClient.init (sync import) 180ms -> Eval chart lib 60ms
KVCache miss rate: 42% (baseline 13%) -> requests to tiles backend increased 2.8x
```

alex: that's the pattern. Telemetry client is doing eager sync imports (zlib/polyfill + sampler) on init. That blocks eval and amplifies cold LCP. We should lazy-load telemetry or gate it.

maya: can we test reverting the telemetry commit in canary? deploy-bot: canary rollback window at 6219876600 if a rollback PR is opened before then.

sanjay: also noticed the prefetch routing policy TTL was shortened from 30s -> 5s in yesterday's routing tweak, which causes kvcache evictions and more cold fetches. That will worsen latencies if bundle parse is also heavier.

lina: that TTL change was my quick fix for overfetch. Happy to revert to 20s for the canary until we stabilize. Didn't expect the telemetry client to be synchronous.

jamal: short-term mitigation suggestion: wrap telemetry init in a dynamic import so it doesn't block main parse, eg:
```
if (window.__REDWOOD_SCHEDULE_TELEMETRY__) {
  import('./telemetry-client').then(m => m.init())
}
```
This avoids shipping new code paths but prevents blocking on cold start.

alex: agreed. Plan: 1) open rollback PR for telemetry client change (canary) 2) revert prefetch TTL to 20s for eu-canary 3) add a quick dynamic import patch if we need faster mitigation. Long-term: add bundle size budget + feature flag for telemetry.

maya: I'll watch SLOs and heatmaps post-rollback. If we see LCP drop back to baseline we can proceed with an opt-in lazy telemetry rollout.

deploy-bot: rollback PR #3478 opened by maya. Canary rollback queued for 6219876600.

alex: thanks everyone. Please post perf diffs in this thread after rollback. :thumbsup:
